title: Star Touchpad 0.9.10 在 StopWatch 上 60 s 全黑帧归因（issue #293 补充复现）

execution.environment: macOS arm64; read-only attribution of an existing firmware-review job; Device Service native QEMU (stopwatch)

checks.name: firmware_identity
checks.detail: 1320608 bytes and SHA-256 23b62091… match the declared artifact

checks.name: image_and_partition_parse
checks.detail: 16 MiB merged image; bootloader, partition table and ota_0 valid; ota_1 empty; partitions fit; no secure boot

checks.name: virtual_flash
checks.detail: session-isolated cache transport, flash verified; 0 changed bytes after the 60 s window

checks.name: guest_boot_and_application
checks.detail: session running for 60.15 s but serial frozen at 226 B ending at entry 0x403c8920; no IDF banner, no app log

checks.name: frame_readiness
checks.detail: 12 samples over 60 s all 711 B 466x466 black PNG sha256 ec5a0018…; ready_timeout

checks.name: guest_crash_or_reset
checks.detail: no_evidence: panic 0, reboot 0, watchdog 0, no core dump, application_load_count 0

checks.name: qemu_host_abort
checks.detail: qemu stderr only 'Adding SPI flash device'; no assertion or illegal instruction

checks.name: input_path_reached
checks.detail: 5 inputs accepted, 0 frame changes; guest never reached UI input handling

checks.name: board_components_present
checks.detail: PM1, IOE and BMI270 present with values; panel framebuffer readable

checks.name: ble_rwip_register_model
checks.detail: 0x60042000 RWIP handshake outside the 0x6002f000..0x60037fff PHY stub and not covered by patch 0015; reads 0

checks.name: independent_reproduction
checks.detail: prior job-a709b2ca44b7 produced byte-identical serial 20ffb092… and frame ec5a0018… under a different M5Burner version record

checks.name: duplicate_issue_check
checks.detail: searches for Star Touchpad / 0x60042000 / E_NO_FRAME stopwatch matched only open issue 293; no new issue created

checks.name: cpu_pc_sampling
checks.detail: this job's evidence carries no CPU PC samples; 0x60042000 loop location inherited from issue 293

checks.name: elf_symbolization
checks.detail: no ELF uploaded with the review job

checks.name: physical_stopwatch_ble
checks.detail: real StopWatch boot, BLE pairing and HID data plane not exercised

checks.name: model_fix_and_regression
checks.detail: no emulator code changed, nothing pushed to the emulator repository, no issue closed

evidence.note: derived summary; sanitized device MAC, pid, worker id, host paths and endpoints

notes: Failure is attributed to the missing BLE RWIP handshake model for StopWatch, not to the firmware or the merged image.
The same BIN was submitted under a second M5Burner version record and reproduced byte-identical serial and frame hashes.
Issue 293 already tracks this exact firmware SHA; this round only adds independently reproduced evidence.
QEMU backend has been frozen since 2026-11-26 and accepts blocking fixes only; this is a boot-blocking gap.
No emulator code was changed, nothing was pushed to the emulator repository, and no issue was closed.
